title: Option cards
description: Selectable cards with radio-group semantics (arrow keys, single tab stop): icon, name, optional description, neutral selected state (`bg-item-selected` + `border-outline-line` + `text-strong`, no brand tint) and 8px grid gap.
when: Picking one visual option from 2–6 choices (an AI provider, a shipping method, a plan) where a card with an icon or short description reads faster than a radio list.

instead.need: Compact inline radio list without cards
Pick one from a long or searchable list
Pick multiple values with search and chips

a11y: role="radiogroup" with role="radio" and aria-checked; roving tabindex gives the whole group one tab stop.
Arrow keys (←/→/↑/↓) and Home/End move both selection and focus, wrapping around and skipping disabled cards.

examples.title: Provider picker
examples.description: Overline section label above a 2-column grid of option cards.

examples.title: With descriptions
examples.description: Each card can carry a short muted description.
